title: Base Path Hosting, Server-Side Session Persistence, PR Reviewer Diff Isolation & Performance Hardening
summary: Adds configurable subpath hosting via -base-path and settings, server-side session persistence for tabs and review drafts via /api/session, isolated PR reviewer edits with distinct badges and diff folding, expand/collapse all tree controls, event-driven tab lifecycle messaging, and extensive backend concurrency, memory, and bounds safety fixes.

categories.name: Base Path Hosting & Subpath Reverse Proxying
items: Configurable server.basePath in settings and -base-path CLI flag with automatic fallback
Dynamic base href tag injection into HTML for hosting px0 behind subpath reverse proxies
Route-level prefixing and normalization for all HTTP server handlers, static files, and SSE streams
Frontend API client and asset link resolution updated to resolve reliably against baseURI
Scoped metrics and event stream telemetry honoring configured base path prefixes

categories.name: Server-Side Session Persistence & PR Review Mode
items: Server-backed workspace session persistence via /api/session for tabs, tree expansion state, and draft reviews
Isolated PR reviewer edits in diff views with collapsible sections separate from frozen PR changes
Visual YOU badges on reviewer-modified files with dirty ancestor markers across the file explorer
Preserved PR comment composer and reply threads with automated token connection nudges in read-only mode
Unconditional opening of merged PRs without confirmation prompts and preserved diff access when reverting changes
Hidden staging checkboxes in PR tree unless explicitly modified by reviewer

categories.name: Explorer Ergonomics, Animations & Git Panel Polish
items: Batch Expand All and Collapse All controls in the file explorer with bounded batching and cancellation
Skip expanding ignored directories during batch tree expansion to avoid unnecessary traversal overhead
Collapsible commit message textarea saving sidebar vertical space with on-demand AI message generation
Two-column Git panel action grid layout with refined 24px button sizing
Visual action feedback including flash success states on buttons and animated workspace reindexing
Input shake and highlight validation when attempting to commit with an empty message
Inline checkmark confirmation feedback on markdown code block copy buttons

categories.name: Event-Driven Frontend & Developer Tooling
items: Lightweight event bus module decoupling frontend subsystems via tab open, switch, and close lifecycle events
Enabled checkJs TypeScript type checking via tsconfig.json and comprehensive JSDoc annotations across frontend code
Enhanced AI commit message generation prompt with staged file paths and diffstat capped to 32KB
Optimized highlight test walking by skipping git, dependency, and build fixture directories
Refactored Vim help modal into structured HTML concatenation

categories.name: Concurrency, Memory & Backend Safety Fixes
items: Eliminated data races in Index.Children by isolating node slice copies under a read lock
Fixed HTTP gzip writer pooling resets and handled 204 No Content and 304 Not Modified responses cleanly
Thread-safe model lookups under mutex lock in agent batch and prompt execution managers
Defensive boundary clamping for negative columns and character offsets in LSP conversions
Prevented bounds panics by clamping slice indices in search snippet helper
Preserved original query casing in fuzzyScore for exact uppercase match bonuses
Throttled Git status refreshes and change-aware tab reloads to eliminate redundant DOM repainting and tab flickering
Comprehensive docstrings and field comments across backend Go types, LSP handlers, and GitWatcher
Documented client-server RAM breakdown across benchmarks clarifying Go daemon and browser tab memory usage
